name: mathmodel-studio
description: 数学建模竞赛论文全流程助手：选题、建模、验算、写作、图表、模拟评审、打包提交，按阶段走完一篇可提交的论文。

interface.shortDescription: 数学建模竞赛全流程助手：从选题到终审提交，按阶段走完一篇可提交的论文
interface.longDescription: An end-to-end coach for math modeling contests. It walks you through problem selection, modeling, solving, validation, paper writing, figure generation with automatic quality checks, traceable numbers, and a simulated judge-panel review before submission. Covers six contests including the China Graduate Contest (Huawei Cup), CUMCM, Huashu Cup, MCM/ICM, Diangong Cup and APMCM, built on a knowledge base distilled from award-winning papers.
defaultPrompt: Use $mathmodel-studio to open the practical workbench.
Use $mathmodel-studio to compare A/B/C problem choices.
Use $mathmodel-studio to plan and generate paper figures.
Use $mathmodel-studio to review a modeling paper draft.
Use $mathmodel-studio to start an APMCM Chinese contest workflow.
Use $mathmodel-studio to retrieve case and question-level evidence across CUMCM, the graduate contest, and Huashu Cup.
Use $mathmodel-studio to generate a dynamic paper plan and audit every abstract claim.
